profile.headline: Software Engineer at GoFi
profile.summary:
As a highly motivated software engineer, I'm driven by a passion for tackling real-world technical challenges. I am committed to enhancing my existing skills and expanding my knowledge of emerging technologies.

With a solid foundation in computer science, I bring a wealth of experience to my work as a backend engineer, where I specialize in Node.js and TypeScript. I thrive in dynamic, collaborative environments and am always eager to take on new projects that challenge and inspire me.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the development of innovative applications, creating rapid growth opportunities in emerging markets saving 2+ days of manual work.

- Developed a highly efficient process, allowing companies to syndicate thousands of listings to real estate marketplaces, such as Zillow and Realtor

- Create Salesforce Lightning Apps to increase efficiency in Lead conversion by 24 hours
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Development and +12 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Led the creation of a new policy system that maintains all of the company critical data, effectively transitioning it from the legacy mainframe system to a modern platform

- Designed and created an EDI reporting process that reported the company’s fleet of hundreds of thousands of vehicles to the DMV

- Improved the user experience of the websites using the best practices in modern web development, resulting in 50%+ increase in web-based claims submissions, accompanied by a reduction in phone-based submissions.
positions.insights: Software Design, ASP.NET MVC and +17 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created an auditing application that performed thorough scans of all company-owned factories, ensuring compliance and increasing overall production of factories.

- Supported the production line by debugging and fixing software issues, empowering a smooth production operation
positions.insights: Software Design, Software Development and +6 skills

projects.title: Dr. Discovery
projects.description: An iOS mobile application to be used with Estimote Beacons inside a museum to provide users with a real time tour of the exhibits.
